name: Business/Investor Entry (via ANIE Guichet Unique)

qualifying_event.description: A foreign investor establishing a business in Chad registers through ANIE (Agence Nationale des Investissements et des Exportations)'s 'Guichet Unique' (single window) business-creation service, and enters/resides using the business category of the visa de séjour.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Business registration through ANIE's Guichet Unique; company letter/registration documents.

requirements.blocker_text: Business registered through ANIE's Guichet Unique (single-window business creation service).
Company letter supporting the business-category visa de séjour application.

outcome.duration_length: 1 month (single entry) or 3 months (multiple entries) at entry, per the underlying visa de séjour; longer-term residence terms for investors not confirmed

sources.title: ANIE (Agence Nationale des Investissements et des Exportations, Chad's government investment promotion agency) -- Guichet Unique single-window business-creation service confirmed to exist; the fetched page did not return substantive content on investment thresholds or incentive terms in this pass
Embassy of Chad in Paris (official Chadian diplomatic mission) -- visa information sheet: business category of the 'visa de séjour' requires a company letter
